decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission P/2024/0848 dated 29/10/2024. 
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004
Condition : 2 - In accordance with approved plans
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:
4.HMF.P.15, 4.HMF.P.14, 4.HMF.P.11, 4.HMF.P.10, 4.HMF.P.01 received 24/04/2025
4.HMF.P.12 Rev A received 25/06/2025
4.HMF.P.13 Rev B, 4.HMF.P.04 Rev B, 4.HMF.P.03 Rev B, 4.HMF.P.02 Rev B received 01/07/2025
and shall conform in all other respects to the drawings and documentations approved under planning permission: P/2024/0848
2224.HMF.000, 2224.HMF.001, 2224.HMF.002, 2224.HMF.003, 2224.HMF.004, 2224.HMF.010, 2224.HMF.011, 2224.HMF.012, 2224.HMF.013, 2224.HMF.014, 2224.HMF.015, Fire Strategy Statement, Flood Risk Assessment received 03/05/2024
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - Previous approved air source heat pump shall not be used until a post completion noise assessment for protecting the neighbours from noise associated with the air source heat pump has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved scheme shall be retained as such thereafter. The noise from this ASHP shall not exceed 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level when measured at the boundary of the nearest noise-sensitive property.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.
description: Variation of condition 2 Approved Plans to change the internal and external design of the single storey rear extension and to allow the removal of the approved the basement and removal of condition 4 basement use, condition 5 Construction Method Statement , condition 6 considerate constructors scheme and condition 7 construction logistics plan in relation to the basement of planning permission P/2024/0848 approved 29/10/2024 Erection of a part one part two storey side extension and a single storey rear wrap around extension. Enlargement of the basement. Formation of a vehicular access at front of site with electric vehicle charging point. Erection of front boundary wall and gate. Installation of Air source heat pump at rear of property following the partial demolition of the existing single storey side and rear extension and side bay.
